objective: Measure how each sentinel-retaining distinct ARC Topic identity changes yield within the complete accepted Pilot 007 119-DOI corpus.

date_window.source_scope: inclusive ARC months before exact-day exclusions

trigger_evidence.rule: A separate extension plan may test accepted-corpus yield only for labels that resolve to one exact numeric ConceptID in both probes.

comparison.multi_topic_union: reconcile the separately filtered canonical DOI sets offline
comparison.reason_for_offline_union: Repeated Topic selection Boolean semantics are not assumed. Separate source calls measure each identity and permit a transparent at-least-one-Topic union.

acceptance_checks: Every baseline DOI chunk reproduces its complete predeclared canonical DOI set.
Each filtered set is a subset of its paired baseline chunk.
Every typed Topic label resolves visibly to its predeclared numeric ConceptID.
Every event remains at most 100 records and is captured completely.
Every successful JSON has both mandatory sibling screenshots.
No Topic restriction is accepted if any baseline corpus DOI has unclassified eligibility.
